description: This file contains functions related to retrieving and managing plugin statuses within the Mattermost server, including handling plugin status retrieval, cluster-wide plugin status aggregation, and notifying system components of status changes.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Represents a collection of channel-related functionalities, including plugin status management.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents the application context, providing access to plugin status functions via its 'ch' attribute.

methods.name: GetPluginStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific plugin by ID for the current server.

methods.name: GetPluginStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of plugin statuses installed on the current server.

methods.name: GetClusterPluginStatuses
methods.description: Returns plugin statuses across the entire cluster.

methods.name: getClusterPluginStatuses
methods.description: Aggregates plugin statuses from the server and cluster if enabled.

methods.name: notifyPluginStatusesChanged
methods.description: Notifies system administrators via WebSocket about plugin status changes.
